author: Anthony
title: VC hails Poroye's appointment as OSOPADEC chairman
text:
The Vice-Chancellor of Olusegun Agagu University of Science and Technology (OAUSTECH), Okitipupa, Ondo State, Prof Temi Ologunorisa, has lauded the appointment of Biyi Poroye as the new Chairman of the Ondo State Oil Producing Areas Development Commission (OSOPADEC).
In a congratulatory message, Ologunorisa noted that Poroye’s appointment was a testament to his leadership skills, expertise, and dedication to the development of Ondo State.
He expressed confidence that the new OSOPADEC boss would work tirelessly to ensure the optimal development of the oil-producing areas in the state, leveraging his experience and vision to make a positive impact.
The Governor’s Chief Press Secretary, Ebenezer Adeniyan, who announced the appointment, said the new board is expected to build on the foundation laid by the previous administration, aligning with the state’s OUR EASE agenda for the betterment of the people in the mandate areas.
